mechanism: Both drugs are beta-lactam/macrolide antibiotics with potential for additive GI effects and rare cross-reactivity in penicillin-allergic patients; azithromycin may slightly inhibit amoxicillin metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Combination is generally acceptable for serious infections requiring broad-spectrum coverage, but monitor for GI disturbances and assess penicillin allergy status; avoid if true IgE-mediated penicillin allergy present.
